entries.scope_en: 2026-10-30 · MMLU200 full answers and 4K/16K continuous load
entries.method_zh: MMLU200：max8192、EOS开启、同时提交200题，无额外任务预热。连续负载：C8、out256，每档60秒预热、300秒提交后排空；B0沿用原封存轮。旧轮协议原样保留。
entries.method_en: MMLU200: max8192, EOS enabled, 200 simultaneous submissions, no extra task warmup. Continuous load: C8, out256, 60s warmup then 300s submissions and drain; B0 reuses its sealed original run. Original protocol retained.

entries.scope_zh: r5在服务ready前失败，由r6修复替代；本版没有正式推理成绩。
entries.scope_en: r5 failed before service readiness and was superseded by r6; no formal inference scores exist for this version.
entries.method_zh: 增加token-progress预热与编译封边；r6随后修复compile-only positions预热对私有runner的使用。
entries.method_en: Added token-progress warmup and compilation sealing; r6 then fixed compile-only positions warmup to use a private runner.

entries.scope_zh: 固定五数据集，另有上下文与四租户配对。
entries.scope_en: Five fixed profiles, with additional context and four-tenant pairs.

entries.method_zh: 复用r6完整报告中已封存的固定B0实测，与r7连续负载比较：同模型、C8、out256、71条共同启动预热，每档60秒预热、300秒提交后排空。两轮日期、B0封存身份和原始数值保留；r6→r7开发对照另列详情。
entries.method_en: Reuse the sealed fixed B0 observations from the r6 complete report for comparison with r7: same model, C8, out256,71 shared startup warmups,60s phase warmup then300s submissions and drain. Original run dates, B0 seal identity and values are retained; r6→r7 development comparisons are separate details.

entries.scope_zh: 固定五项每臂672请求均完成；另完成真实4K/16K/32K上下文及四租户配对，正式请求零失败。
entries.scope_en: All five fixed profiles completed672 requests per arm; separate real4K/16K/32K context and four-tenant pairs also completed with no formal failures.
entries.method_zh: 固定MMLU200、HLE四层比例200、Frontier160、SWE32任务/64请求、Terminal32任务/48请求。两臂使用各自冻结预算和共同预热协议，预热及同模型辅助评分不计入正式性能。吞吐计入整批排空；TPOT按请求等权平均。连续负载另按C8/out256/300秒提交后排空。 本轮真实历史专项使用5份完整公开SWE/Terminal历史，C8及四租户C24，各预热60秒、正式提交300秒后排空，out256、seed17、ignore_eos；全部窗口和租户分布保留。
entries.method_en: Fixed MMLU200, stratified HLE200, Frontier160, SWE32 tasks/64 requests and Terminal32 tasks/48 requests. Both arms retain the frozen answer budgets and common warmup protocol. Warmup and same-model grading are excluded from performance. Throughput includes cohort drain; TPOT is request-weighted. Continuous load separately uses C8/out256 and 300s submissions plus drain. The real-history supplement uses five complete published SWE/Terminal histories at C8 and four-tenant C24, each with60s warmup,300s submissions plus drain, out256, seed17 and EOS ignored; all windows and tenant distributions are retained.
entries.quality_note_zh: HLE每臂各1题评分未解析，Frontier为4/8题；均保留在原计划分母。长度终止单列。SWE/Terminal仅测轨迹推理性能，不测Agent解决率。
entries.quality_note_en: One unresolved HLE grade per arm; Frontier has 4/8. All remain in the planned denominator. Length stops are separate. SWE/Terminal measure trace inference, not agent solve rates.

protocol.task_selection: First five source-hash-ranked tasks in the frozen SWE32+Terminal32 population with one complete unchanged published request in each declared band; first eligible source-order request per band. No score, speed, answer, cropping or padding filter.
protocol.tenant_identity: Four independent closed-loop client queues; OpenAI user field tenant-0..3 and unique per-request cache salts. Shared engine/resources; no security-isolation or dedicated-VM claim.
protocol.acceptance: Preserve the original qualitative throughput/tail stability and high utilization criteria; no invented pass threshold. Complete execution produces measurements, not an automatic numerical pass.
protocol.source_tasks_are_not_concurrency: Five distinct real histories; eight closed-loop lanes cycle the fixed cases, repetitions are not independent task samples.

utilization.method: Sampler clock midpoint; request interval clipped; left-hold, time weighted. A sample estimate, not continuous hardware truth.

limits: Five distinct histories; repetitions and sixty-second windows are not independent task samples.
The formal submission window is300 seconds and all requests drain afterward. Each window reports its own drain.
Four logical tenant queues share one engine and device pair; this does not measure security isolation.
Utilization is a time-weighted device sample estimate, separate from effective compute.
Preserve the original qualitative context/tenant requirements; no new numerical pass threshold is imposed.

entries.scope_en: Qwen completed MMLU200,Frontier160 and continuous C8 4K/16K. HLE service startup failed before formal requests; later stages did not execute. Intern integration remains separate.

entries.method_en: Reuse sealed fixed Original018 B0, preserving task order,output budgets,shared warmup and compilation seals. Replay completed originals without new inference. Continuous C8 does not replace the context/tenant supplement.

entries.label_zh: 冻结候选 · Qwen 固定五项配对实测
entries.label_en: Frozen candidate · Qwen fixed-five paired measurements
entries.scope_zh: 源码冻结的 r10 候选。双 Ascend 910B2，Qwen3.5-35B-A3B BF16 TP2。固定五项每臂 672 条请求，另有 4K、16K C8。B0 为封存 Original018 实测。HLE 和 FrontierScience 的两臂分别调用同一 r10 裁判。
entries.scope_en: Source-pinned R10 candidate. Dual Ascend 910B2, Qwen3.5-35B-A3B BF16 TP2. The fixed five contain 672 requests per arm, with separate 4K and 16K C8 cohorts. B0 uses admitted Original018 measurements. Both HLE and FrontierScience arms are graded separately by the same R10 model.
entries.method_zh: 固定题目、请求预算与预热。复用经原件复核的 B0、两臂 MMLU 和 r10 C8。C8 每档提交 300 秒，每请求输出 256 token。吞吐计入排空，裁判请求独立计时。SWE 与 Terminal 按冻结公开轨迹测服务性能。 原始证据包含独立的原生 RMS 修订配对、C8 和连续写回组件报告。
entries.method_en: Fixed inputs, budgets and warmup. B0, both MMLU arms and R10 C8 reuse replay-verified seals. Each C8 cohort submits for 300 seconds with 256 output tokens per request. Throughput includes drain. Judging is timed separately. SWE and Terminal measure frozen public trace inference. Original evidence also includes the separate native RMS revision pairs, C8, and contiguous-write component study.
entries.quality_note_zh: HLE 和 FrontierScience 的未决保留在计划分母，长度终止单列。SWE 和 Terminal 只统计推理服务性能。 原生 RMS 修复版同期复查为 HLE 65/200、FrontierScience 66/160。修复版与组件原型的完整结果见原始证据。
entries.quality_note_en: Unresolved HLE and FrontierScience grades remain in the planned denominator. Length stops are recorded separately. SWE and Terminal measure inference-service performance only. The native RMS revision scored 65/200 on HLE and 66/160 on FrontierScience. Its full results and component prototype evidence are in Original evidence.

metric_policy: Each observation retains its own control, protocol and source. No historical metric is substituted for an unmeasured version. All durations include response drain; TPOT is request-weighted.

baseline.observation_policy: Fixed B0 engine/image/configuration across releases. Dated measurements retain their own protocol, original values and seal; baseline reuse is explicit. B1-vs-B1 development pairs are never the main comparison denominator.
